Messages.Author: DeathInABottle
Messages.Body:
Morlock, who has one blood, plays Force of Will at inferior. The
action is successful. Before the action resolves, he plays
Transfusion at [nec], leaving him with no blood. He then burns. Is
this correct, or do I have the timing wrong?

Force of Will
Only usable by a tapped vampire.
[for] (D) Bleed with +1 bleed. After resolution, this vampire takes 2
unpreventable aggravated damage even if the action is blocked.
[FOR] As above, but with +2 bleed, and the acting vampire takes only 1
unpreventable aggravated damage.

Transfusion
[nec] Only usable after a successful action. Add 1 blood to a ready
vampire.
[thn] As [nec] above, but add 1 life to a ghoul or 1 blood to a ready
vampire.
[THN] Only usable after combat if this vampire is still ready and
successfully inflicted any damage on the opposing minion in that
combat. Put a transfusion counter on the opposing minion. If the
minion now has 3 of your transfusion counters, burn them all to take
control of that minion. Only one Transfusion may be played at superior
each turn.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On May 29, 9:14 pm, DeathInABottle <li...@uvic.ca> wrote:
> Morlock, who has one blood, plays Force of Will at inferior.  The
> action is successful.  Before the action resolves, he plays
> Transfusion at [nec], leaving him with no blood.  He then burns.  Is
> this correct, or do I have the timing wrong?

Your quoted text is incorrect: Force of Will costs 1 blood.

So he has no blood left to play Transfusion (which also costs 1 blood,
which you seem to understand above, but which the card text quoted
below also omits).

Assuming instead he started with 2 blood, then he pays one for the
successful action, leaving him with 1 blood, which he then spends on
Transfusion, using it to add blood to some vampire other than himself.

Then he takes two aggravated damage, which burns him, yes.
